funnel.question: Where in the buying journey does this format work best?

tags.label: TOFU
tags.def: Reaches people who do not know you yet: broad topic, curiosity, entertainment.

tags.label: MOFU
tags.def: Builds trust in your expertise, your method or your taste.

tags.label: BOFU
tags.def: Moves people to act: product, demo, proof, objection, offer.

value.question: Why do people watch it to the end and share it?

tags.label: Educational
tags.def: The viewer learns something they can use or repeat.

tags.label: Humour
tags.def: The viewer laughs.

tags.label: Surprising
tags.def: An unexpected fact, twist or reveal resets attention.

tags.label: Shocking
tags.def: Strong, provocative or transgressive: controversy, taboo, rage bait. Use with care.

tags.label: Social currency
tags.def: Sharing it makes the sharer look smart, early or part of a group (Jonah Berger, Contagious, 2013).

tags.label: Emotional
tags.def: Moves the viewer: pride, awe, sadness, inspiration. Proposed in v0.1, to validate.

tags.label: Relatable
tags.def: The viewer recognizes themselves or someone they know ("that is so me") and tags a friend. Proposed in v0.1, to validate.

structure.question: What happens on screen, in order? The narrative skeleton.

tags.label: Founder story
tags.def: One moment from the founder's path that explains why the company exists.

tags.label: Story
tags.def: Someone else's story told with a setup, a turn and a payoff (a company, a historical figure, a customer).

tags.label: Storytime
tags.def: A personal anecdote told to camera, often a confession or a mishap.

tags.label: Reaction
tags.def: The creator reacts to another video, post or piece of news and adds a point of view.

tags.label: Comment reply
tags.def: A full video that answers one comment shown on screen.

tags.label: Demo
tags.def: The product or a tool is shown working on a real task.

tags.label: Tutorial
tags.def: Step-by-step instructions the viewer can follow.

tags.label: Explainer
tags.def: One concept, mechanism or question explained simply.

tags.label: Myth vs data
tags.def: A common belief, then the evidence that breaks it (debunk).

tags.label: Hot take
tags.def: A strong opinion defended in under a minute.

tags.label: List
tags.def: N tips, N mistakes, N reasons, delivered one by one.

tags.label: Tier list
tags.def: Items ranked or rated from best to worst (tiers, grades, 0 to 10), one reason each.

tags.label: Teardown
tags.def: A public example or a real case (a page, an ad, a launch, a video, a customer's setup) taken apart to show what works.

tags.label: News
tags.def: One piece of news explained quickly, with what it changes.

tags.label: Prediction
tags.def: A dated bet about the future, with the signals behind it.

tags.label: Before and after
tags.def: A transformation shown in two states.

tags.label: Challenge or series
tags.def: Day X of Y, a recurring challenge or a numbered series that brings viewers back.

tags.label: Prank
tags.def: A staged surprise on real people, revealed at the end.

tags.label: Stunt
tags.def: A public action staged to be talked about: a flash mob, a namesake, an outrageous announcement.

tags.label: Social experiment
tags.def: A test run on real people to see how they react.

tags.label: Experiment
tags.def: A test run on products, objects or yourself to see what happens: which one is faster, does it survive, does the routine work.

tags.label: Street interview
tags.def: Questions asked to strangers on the street.

tags.label: Interview
tags.def: A question and answer with a guest, on camera.

tags.label: Podcast clip
tags.def: The strongest moment of a long conversation, cut as a short.

tags.label: Skit
tags.def: A short scripted scene with roles, often a POV or an office situation.

tags.label: Day in the life
tags.def: A day or a moment of work followed from the inside.

tags.label: Behind the scenes
tags.def: How something is made, from the inside.

tags.label: Build in public
tags.def: A real decision, metric or step of the company, shared while it happens.

tags.label: Objection
tags.def: A buyer objection answered on camera.

tags.label: Quiz
tags.def: A question, riddle or guess the viewer answers before the reveal.

tags.label: Versus
tags.def: Two options compared, sometimes blind, with a verdict.

tags.label: Trend
tags.def: A platform trend, sound or meme reused with your topic.

tags.label: Testimonial
tags.def: A customer or user tells what changed for them.

tags.label: Review
tags.def: A product tried and judged, with a verdict.

tags.label: Unboxing
tags.def: A product opened and discovered on camera.

tags.label: Announcement
tags.def: A launch, a teaser or an event, presented as news.

tags.label: Giveaway
tags.def: A prize hidden in the comments, the product or the video, found by the audience.

tags.label: Process
tags.def: A making-of or a satisfying process shown step by step.

tags.label: Song
tags.def: An original song or a parody carries the message.

tags.label: Debate
tags.def: Two or more people argue a question on camera.

tags.label: Expert test
tags.def: An expert faces a test, a game or a rival and must prove it live.

setup.question: How is it shot and edited?

tags.label: Facecam
tags.def: One person talks to the camera, framed and edited.

tags.label: Yapping
tags.def: A raw, unscripted, high-energy monologue to the front camera, often in a car or while walking, few cuts.

tags.label: Greenscreen
tags.def: The speaker in front of an image, article, post or chart used as background.

tags.label: Motion design
tags.def: Animated graphics, charts or text carry the explanation.

tags.label: B-roll
tags.def: Footage of places, products or actions that illustrates the voice.

tags.label: Voice-over
tags.def: A voice heard over footage, the speaker not on screen.

tags.label: Screen recording
tags.def: A computer or phone screen recorded, with or without a face in the corner.

tags.label: Text only
tags.def: Text on screen carries the content: slideshow, photo carousel, text on a still.

tags.label: POV camera
tags.def: First-person footage: glasses, chest or head camera.

tags.label: Street
tags.def: Shot outdoors with strangers or in public places.

tags.label: Studio
tags.def: A set with two or more cameras: podcast table, interview set.

tags.label: Duet or stitch
tags.def: The platform's own tools to answer or react to another video.

tags.label: Split screen
tags.def: Two videos side by side or stacked.

tags.label: Cinematic
tags.def: Film-like shots, lighting and music edit.

tags.label: Walk and talk
tags.def: The speaker walks while talking, the place changes behind them.

tags.label: Whiteboard
tags.def: Drawing on a board, a tablet or paper while explaining.

tags.label: Animation
tags.def: 2D, 3D or AI-generated images and characters.

tags.label: UGC style
tags.def: A creator films a product at home, phone in hand, like a customer would.

tags.label: Two-shot
tags.def: Two people in frame talking to each other.

tags.label: Multi-role
tags.def: One person plays several characters, cut together.

tags.label: Phone call
tags.def: A phone or video call acted or shown on camera, often on speaker in an office.

tags.label: Live clip
tags.def: A moment cut from a livestream or a webinar.

tags.label: On site
tags.def: Shot where the work happens: factory, shop, kitchen, office, workshop.

tags.label: Archive footage
tags.def: Historical images, film clips or third-party footage, used within platform rules.

origin.mimetic: Copies a shape that already performs on the platform.
origin.original: Built around one person, place or product, hard to copy.

founder_on_camera.yes: The founder must be on camera.

effort.low: Phone, under 30 minutes from idea to export.
effort.medium: Half a day: script, shoot, edit.
effort.high: Crew, actors, locations or heavy edit.

status.tested: Shot at least once in a real program.
status.proven: Kept after a format review on mature data.
